## What is Changed

### Fixed

- The sidebar header read the plugin name and version from hardcoded constants, so it kept showing `0.1.0` after the package had moved to `0.2.0`. Both values are now read from `package.json` at build time, so the header tracks the released version automatically.


## Full Changelog
https://github.com/jn-s3s/opencode-tui-quota-usage/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1

## What is Changed

### Changed

- Renamed the TUI setup guidance command from `/quota-providers` to `/quota-help`.
- A disabled provider is now hidden from the sidebar instead of appearing as a section marked `Disabled · /quota-<provider>`. One hint row names every provider that is currently off, so a hidden provider can still be turned back on.
- Added a persistent right-aligned `/quota-help for help` footer to the sidebar.
- A successful refresh now carries forward `plan`, `activeUntil` and `accessEndsAt` from the previous snapshot instead of clearing them. Carried-over values keep their original fetch time and render with a `(stale)` suffix once older than 5 minutes, so a subscription boundary whose follow-up lookup keeps failing is no longer shown as current.


## Full Changelog
https://github.com/jn-s3s/opencode-tui-quota-usage/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

## Quota sidebar foundation
- Initial release adds a read-only quota sidebar for the OpenCode V2 CLI and TUI, bundled from `src/tui.tsx` into `dist/tui.js` and loaded as a CLI-only plugin through `~/.config/opencode/cli.json`.

## Provider tracking
- OpenCode Go and Go Plus section shows 5h, Weekly and Monthly windows as percent-left meters with a reset countdown, staying disabled by default until enabled with `/quota-opencode`.
- Codex section shows 5h and Weekly windows read from the Codex CLI `auth.json`, enabled separately with `/quota-codex`.

## Setup and live updates
- Go API key is stored in Windows Credential Manager with an `OPENCODE_QUOTA_GO_API_KEY` environment fallback and an optional `OPENCODE_QUOTA_GO_ORG_ID` for best-effort plan and access status.
- New TUI commands `/quota-usage` for sidebar visibility, `/quota-providers` for setup guidance and `/quota-opencode-key` for Go credential and org ID management.
- Provider sections collapse independently, enabled providers refresh every 2 minutes, a 30 second countdown clock keeps the display current and warning or critical thresholds trigger at 45% and 10% left.

## Breaking Changes
None.
